note: Pins the entrypoint observation vocabulary and the non-terminal observability-install refusal vocabulary exercised by the focused contract tests. A refused metrics install records kernel.observability_install_refused carrying one static owner-issued code and never a kernel.terminal_error; exit_error stays the sole kernel.terminal_error emitter ON THE ENTRYPOINT FUNNEL; the library modules keep their own per-operation terminal records and are out of this card scope. Codes are fixed vocabulary only: no dynamic Display prose, no raw paths, frames or whole-error strings. Both observability_refusal_codes keys are looked up by name through pinned.get(variant_path) in the inline test in src/main.rs, so a renamed KernelObservabilityError variant or a changed code is red there and this fixture cannot drift away from the Rust mapping silently. The full 24-case matrix (complete entrypoint/error/propagation inventory, per-stage failure distinctions, canary sweeps) is deferred to the owning follow-ups, as are the markers outside 895/2,/3,/4; this fixture covers only the facade-init, single-observation and install-refusal proofs.
